editionNote: Twiki uses the alternate voice in this edition.
description: After awakening five centuries in the future, Buck Rogers struggles to find his place on a rebuilt Earth while working alongside Colonel Wilma Deering and Dr. Huer. His missions for Earth Defense bring him repeatedly into conflict with Princess Ardala and Kane, as well as assassins, criminals and hostile worlds that test both his twentieth-century instincts and his growing loyalty to the 25th century.

s01e01-02.description: Buck Rogers awakens five centuries after a space accident, discovers a rebuilt Earth and becomes caught between Earth Defense and Princess Ardala’s covert Draconian invasion plan.

s01e03-04.description: A poisoned food supply cripples Earth’s defense forces and sends Buck and Wilma to Vistula, where the charismatic Kaleel is preparing an attack on Earth.

s01e05.description: Buck is sent to a pleasure city to rescue Falina Redding, whose stolen memories contain information that could devastate a criminal empire.

s01e06.description: Buck goes undercover inside the Legion of Death to discover how the assassins plan to avenge a fallen member by striking New Chicago.

s01e07.description: With the Legion’s sabotage plan exposed, Buck races back to Earth to stop an attack on the power system that supports New Chicago.

s01e08.description: A stolen nerve-gas threat forces Wilma to seek help from a veteran pilot who knows the only safe route through a deadly asteroid belt.

s01e09.description: Buck enters an android-run prison to break out a woman who may know how criminal Mallory Pantera has been crippling Earth’s trade.

s01e10.description: Buck is lured to Zantia and kidnapped into a society desperate for men, complicating Earth’s already fragile negotiations with the Ruathans.

s01e11.description: Buck becomes involved in rescuing an eleven-year-old political leader who, like Buck, survived from the twentieth century through suspended animation.

s01e12.description: Princess Ardala threatens Earth with a powerful weapon unless Buck agrees to marry her, forcing him to search her ship for the weapon’s control center.

s01e13.description: Buck guards the genetically exceptional Miss Cosmos aboard a luxury cruise while thieves plot to abduct her for the value of her genetic material.

s01e14.description: A planned surprise birthday for a homesick Buck is interrupted when a long-imprisoned enemy targets Dr. Huer for revenge.

s01e15.description: Ardala lures Buck onto a fake twentieth-century spacecraft and Kane creates android duplicates of him for a planned attack on Earth.

s01e16.description: A space warp carries Buck into another universe where peaceful Pendar is threatened by Zarina, forcing an uneasy alliance with Princess Ardala.

s01e17.description: Buck and the combined Pendaran-Draconian force confront Zarina’s battlecruiser in the struggle to save Pendar.
